annotations.title: Find rooms on target levels that share or contain TYPE parti

description: Find rooms on target levels that share or contain TYPE partition walls taller than a threshold. Uses room boundary segment ElementIds so shared room-to-room walls are assigned to both rooms, and can add upward ray evidence from room bottom to floor underside.

autoDetectLevels.description: When true and levels is omitted, scan all placed-room levels and let tall TYPE walls identify candidates.

excludeRoomNameContains.description: Room name keywords to exclude. Defaults include shafts, stairs, and elevators.

includeRoomRayHeight.description: Add ray-cast evidence from room bottom to the nearest floor underside above sampled points.

includeSingleRoomBoundaryWalls.description: Include tall TYPE walls that only appear on one target room boundary. Set false to keep only walls shared by two or more target rooms.

levels.description: Level names to scan. Defaults to B-1F and B-3F unless autoDetectLevels is true.

maxSearchDistanceMm.description: Maximum upward/downward floor search distance used by the ray helper.

minWallHeightMm.description: Minimum wall height in millimeters. Default is 6000.

sampleGrid.description: Room ray sample grid size, clamped to 1-7. Default 3.

wallTypeContains.description: Case-insensitive wall type name keyword for partition walls.
